text:
Evan: hi team — two quick onboarding things i ran into after enrolling
Evan: 1) my dental carrier shows "pending" in the portal; dentist appointment next week — worried they'll deny at checkin
Evan: 2) i uploaded receipts for a pre-start travel reimbursement but Concur shows 'awaiting approval' and no idea timeline
Rae (People Ops): welcome Evan! for the dentist, we can issue a temporary eligibility letter you can print or show on your phone. DM me the appointment details and provider name.
Evan: provider: SmileWorks Downtown, appt 2026-04-02 10:30am
Olga (Benefits): thanks Evan  i see your dental enrollment queued with carrier DeltaDent. processing delay sometimes happens on their side up to 72 hours. i'll send the eligibility letter now.
OnboardingBot: Eligibility letter for Evan (employee 18290) generated and posted to DM.
Evan: got it, saved it. thanks! about the reimbursement: my moving company charged me on 3/25 and i uploaded invoice + signed relocation packet in Concur under "Relocation"
Rae (People Ops): relocation reimbursements normally route to People Ops first for policy verification then Finance issues payment. Typical timeline is 2 payroll cycles after approval.
Evan: can i flag it as urgent? i need funds to cover a vendor hold.
PayrollBot: One-off expedited reimbursements can be requested. Submit a ticket to finance-ops with subject "EXPEDITE-RELO <employee id>" and attach the Concur link. Finance prioritizes true hardship cases and will respond within 48 hours.
Evan: will do. any other docs i need to attach for faster approval?
Olga (Benefits): make sure your signed relocation packet includes dates and vendor invoice with vendor tax ID. If you had an outstanding deposit, include the vendor receipt showing deposit amount. That helps speed review.
Evan: thanks. small payroll question: when does PTO start accruing? i joined 2026-03-29 — it showed 0 balance still.
Rae (People Ops): accruals kick on the first of the month following your start for monthly posting, except we prorate an initial partial month balance which posts within 3 business days of onboarding completion. If you don't see it by EOD tomorrow, ping me.
Evan: ok noted. and one more — company holiday policy: manager mentioned a "spring shutdown" day but i can't find it in the calendar
OnboardingBot: Company holiday calendar updated for 2026. Spring shutdown is not a company-wide holiday this year; some teams schedule a team day off. Check your manager's team calendar or ask them to submit the floating holiday in Workday if the team agreed.
Evan: gotcha. thanks everyone. i'll file the expedite ticket and DM Rae if prorated PTO doesn't show.
Rae (People Ops): welcome again! ping anytime. :wave:
PayrollBot: Reminder: to be considered for expedited reimbursements this payroll week, submit finance-ops ticket by COB Wednesday.
